paragraphs.text: Rakhan was an ainok member of Yasova Dragonclaw 's hunting party, two generations after the Khanfall on Tarkir .

Rakhan was a disciplined and skilled hunter, demonstrating reliability and competence as one of Yasova Dragonclaw 's most dependable companions. He, along with his comrades Oiyan , Darka , Mattak , Sorya , and Fec , demonstrated loyalty and competence throughout their journey. Rakhan was involved in the practical tasks of the group, such as kindling a fire and hauling water. Rakhan’s actions and roles within the group showed a capable and physically adept individual suited to the demanding life of a hunter and guardian. He possessed the rugged and practical attire of a hunter, equipped with the necessary tools and weapons for survival and defense.

Rakhan was defined by his reliability, discipline, and practicality. He was a silent and alert presence, always ready for action and quick to adapt to the needs of the group. His stifled grief at Darka 's death indicates a depth of emotion and loyalty to his companions, though he maintained composure under pressure. Rakhan always remained focused on his duties and his ability to work collaboratively with others in a steadfast and supportive nature.

Rakhan's fate is closely tied to the perilous journey and the constant threat posed by the dragons . Despite the immediate danger they faced, such as the close encounter with Atarka , Rakhan survived under the dragonlord's suffering. Rakhan’s role as a guardian and his disciplined nature suggests he would continue to be a vital member of the group, facing whatever challenges arise with resilience and determination.
